easyPrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out with haste.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Declare the token Fear of Missing Out as an attacker. It triggers, untapping another creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.name: Helm of the Host
uses.cardState: attached to Fear of Missing Out
